description: Manual candidate list compiled from PubMed, OpenAlex, source review reference lists, and publisher pages. Entries were reviewed by the user and promoted into the known relevant study set.
review_policy: This file is retained as provenance for the manual expansion pass.
Use source_review_dois and rationale fields to audit why each study was considered relevant.
Future manual expansion passes should use literature-search language: known relevant studies, source reviews, citation chasing, and search completeness checks.

entries.title: Trial of Psilocybin versus Escitalopram for Depression
entries.rationale: Major modern psilocybin comparator trial not present in the current known relevant study set.

entries.title: Reduction in social anxiety after MDMA-assisted psychotherapy with autistic adults: a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot study
entries.rationale: Expands clinical search-completeness coverage beyond depression/PTSD into autistic adults with social anxiety outcomes.

entries.title: Safety and efficacy of lysergic acid diethylamide-assisted psychotherapy for anxiety associated with life-threatening diseases
entries.rationale: Important LSD-assisted therapy trial for anxiety in life-threatening illness.

entries.title: Pilot study of psilocybin treatment for anxiety in patients with advanced-stage cancer
entries.rationale: Earlier psilocybin cancer anxiety study that complements the 2016 cancer distress trials already in the known relevant study set.

entries.title: Lysergic Acid Diethylamide-Assisted Therapy in Patients With Anxiety With and Without a Life-Threatening Illness: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase II Study
entries.rationale: Adds recent LSD anxiety trial coverage.

entries.title: The safety and efficacy of (+/-)3,4-methylenedioxymethamphetamine-assisted psychotherapy in subjects with chronic, treatment-resistant posttraumatic stress disorder: the first randomized controlled pilot study
entries.rationale: Early randomized MDMA-assisted psychotherapy PTSD trial.

entries.title: Safety, tolerability, and efficacy of psilocybin in 9 patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder
entries.rationale: Classic small psilocybin OCD study that broadens disorder coverage.

entries.title: A randomized, controlled pilot study of MDMA (+/- 3,4-Methylenedioxymethamphetamine)-assisted psychotherapy for treatment of resistant, chronic Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
entries.rationale: Phase 2-era randomized MDMA PTSD trial.

entries.title: 3,4-Methylenedioxymethamphetamine-assisted psychotherapy for treatment of chronic posttraumatic stress disorder: A randomized phase 2 controlled trial
entries.rationale: Additional MDMA PTSD phase 2 trial distinct from the Lancet Psychiatry veteran/firefighter/police officer trial already present.

entries.title: Single-dose psilocybin-assisted therapy in major depressive disorder: A placebo-controlled, double-blind, randomised clinical trial
entries.rationale: Modern MDD randomized trial absent from the current known relevant study set.

entries.title: MDMA-assisted psychotherapy for treatment of anxiety and other psychological distress related to life-threatening illnesses: a randomized pilot study
entries.rationale: Adds MDMA-assisted therapy outside PTSD.

entries.title: Psilocybin with psychological support for treatment-resistant depression: six-month follow-up
entries.rationale: Useful for follow-up coverage, but should be reviewed before being counted as a primary-trial completeness check.

entries.title: Psilocybin-assisted psychotherapy for treatment resistant depression: A randomized clinical trial evaluating repeated doses of psilocybin
entries.rationale: Newer repeated-dose psilocybin randomized trial.

entries.title: A randomized clinical trial of repeated doses of psilocybin for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder
entries.rationale: Recent OCD trial found by targeted PubMed search; needs full manual check because it postdates several source reviews.

entries.title: Efficacy and Safety of Psilocybin in Treatment-Resistant Major Depression: The EPISODE Randomized Clinical Trial
entries.rationale: Recent active-placebo randomized psilocybin TRD trial found by targeted PubMed search.

entries.title: Psilocybin therapy for females with anorexia nervosa: a phase 1, open-label feasibility study
entries.rationale: Adds eating-disorder coverage; source was targeted PubMed/Nature search rather than a selected systematic review.

entries.title: Psilocybin-occasioned mystical experiences in the treatment of tobacco addiction
entries.rationale: Early psilocybin-facilitated smoking cessation study.

entries.title: Single-dose psilocybin therapy for alcohol use disorder: Pharmacokinetics, feasibility, safety and efficacy in an open-label study
entries.rationale: Newer AUD open-label study; useful for current coverage but not a completeness-check item without full-text review.

entries.title: Ayahuasca Improves Self-perception of Speech Performance in Subjects With Social Anxiety Disorder: A Pilot, Proof-of-Concept, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial
entries.rationale: Adds ayahuasca/social anxiety coverage.

entries.title: Psilocybin or Nicotine Patch for Smoking Cessation: A Pilot Randomized Clinical Trial
entries.rationale: Recent smoking-cessation randomized trial found by targeted search; should be checked because it is newer than the source reviews.

entries.title: Psychedelics and the Human Receptorome
entries.rationale: Reference work with broad receptor affinity data across psychedelic compounds.

entries.title: Receptor interaction profiles of novel psychoactive tryptamines compared with classic hallucinogens

entries.title: Interaction of psychoactive tryptamines with biogenic amine transporters and serotonin receptor subtypes
entries.rationale: Direct monoamine transporter and serotonin receptor assay coverage for psychoactive tryptamines.

entries.title: Receptor Interaction Profiles of 4-Alkoxy-3,5-Dimethoxy-Phenethylamines (Mescaline Derivatives) and Related Amphetamines
entries.rationale: Adds phenethylamine/mescaline-derivative receptor profile coverage.

entries.title: The hallucinogen N,N-dimethyltryptamine (DMT) is an endogenous sigma-1 receptor regulator
entries.rationale: Canonical DMT sigma-1 receptor mechanistic paper.

entries.title: Salvinorin A: A potent naturally occurring nonnitrogenous kappa opioid selective agonist
entries.rationale: Canonical salvinorin A kappa-opioid receptor selectivity paper; DOI should be verified during manual review.

entries.title: Studies toward the pharmacophore of salvinorin A, a potent kappa opioid receptor agonist
entries.rationale: Additional salvinorin A KOR pharmacophore/binding coverage.

entries.title: Neurochemical profiles of some novel psychoactive substances
entries.rationale: Adds NBOMe/NPS neurochemical profile coverage.

entries.title: Crystal Structure of an LSD-Bound Human Serotonin Receptor

entries.title: Identification of a serotonin/glutamate receptor complex implicated in psychosis

entries.title: Hallucinogens Recruit Specific Cortical 5-HT2A Receptor-Mediated Signaling Pathways to Affect Behavior

entries.title: Agonist-directed signaling of the serotonin 2A receptor depends on beta-arrestin-2 interactions in vivo
entries.rationale: Biased/agonist-directed 5-HT2A signaling paper relevant to psychedelic mechanism claims.

entries.title: Structural pharmacology and therapeutic potential of 5-methoxytryptamines

entries.title: Structural insights into tryptamine psychedelics: The role of hydroxyl indole ring site in 5-HT2A receptor activation and psychedelic-like activity
entries.rationale: Recent psilocin/tryptamine 5-HT2A activation paper found by targeted search.
